earlier_direction: Rev01: forward loop around the engine before routing aft
selected_direction: Rev03: direct aft route from cylinder side to stern; forward loop removed
authority: User routing sketch and project instruction, 10 October 2026
selection_rationale: Compact packaging is the project goal; eliminating the forward loop avoids allocating that part of the engine bay to the exhaust.
A cylinder-side-to-stern corridor is intended to reduce obstruction around the central assembly and help plan hatch access, tools and component removal.
Develop the installed system around a pump/crankshaft axis on the hull centre plane; shaft height and coupling details remain provisional.
evidence_status: Selected routing direction, not a manufacturing release, tuned exhaust or verified installed clearance
open_checks: Usable inner hull, laminate thickness and hatch underside
Plug, starter, head and full engine removal envelopes
Thermal shielding and separation from fuel, intake, wiring and hoses
Port timing, expansion geometry, gas temperature, effective acoustic length, silencer and pressure-wave model
Outlet height, drainage and water-ingress protection
change_policy: Retain Rev01 and Rev03; later changes receive dated revisions and reasons. No demonstrated power, mass, drag or endurance improvement is claimed.
